channel.description: Recent content in Categories on By Lantern Light

item.title: Twelve Duchies
item.description: Follow the Twelve Duchies, an original fantasy setting explored through solo Old-School Essentials adventures. Read the session reports, discover its deities and factions, and browse the encounter tables and house rules.

item.title: Rules and Tools
item.description: Browse random tables, house rules and tools for tabletop roleplaying games. These posts collect ideas and mechanics from my games, including solo adventure prompts and rules for combat and character powers.

item.title: The Library Between Worlds
item.description: Imagine a library between worlds, connecting distant realities and offering a starting point for tabletop adventures. Explore the setting and its world-building ideas here.

item.title: Streetwise
item.description: Streetwise uses the Year Zero Engine for adventures with street urchins in Victorian London. Explore the game concept and the web tools that support play.

item.title: Mountaintop Isolation
item.description: Explore Mountaintop Isolation through a first look at the game and a series of solo horror journal entries. The story unfolds in a remote mountain cabin as isolation, cold and hunger take their toll.
